```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(client_request_duration_seconds_bucket[60m])) by (le, service))

        avg_over_time(client_request_duration_seconds[1h])
          [and(avg_over_time(client_request_duration_seconds[1h]) >= 0.01)]
